side:24.text: There are traces of Sigrún's homeland, Fjöturlund, across the Lake of Nine. Mimir seeks to learn more about her time here I will help my friend in his search. Fjöturlund's crest appears near the wreckage of Týr's shield on the Lake of Nine. We may learn more about Sigrún's past inside. With the treasury door open, we are free to search for clues about Sigrún's past.

boss:6.text: King Hrólf Kraki is a Berserker that appears as an optional boss in God of War Ragnarök. Out of all the berserkers that can be encountered, Hrólf Kraki, like Sigrún of the Valkyries, is the strongest and most powerful out of all of them. He can be found in Midgard. Hrólfr Kraki was a semi-legendary Danish King who appears in both Anglo-Saxon and Norse tradition.
